quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: I've got other matters to settle right now.

dialogue.t: Well, okay. I'll see who else I can get to take this commission.
That would be great, thank you!
Make sure you stay safe. Try not to get attacked by anything in the ruins, and remember not to run too fast, or the dish might fall out.
Please hurry, this dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's right. Silio ordered another serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish today before heading to Stormterror's Lair. Could you help us and deliver this to him real quick?
This serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish can't come into contact with any strange elements, or it might end up tasting funny.
Great! This meal should give me enough energy to finally get out of this blasted place.

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
